description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Foothill Guide, adding {W}.
When Foothill Guide dies, Yedora triggers, returning Foothill Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Foothill Guide by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Foothill Guide's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
